name: FedEx Ground Hub - Grove City OH

fieldNotes.truckGate: Chain-link perimeter fence around the truck yard with a gate across the W-side truck driveway, visible in 2025 Street View (sv6/sv8).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth observed at the yard entrance - gated but unmanned, so remoteGs = true (kiosk / app check-in implied).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long N-S cross-dock building with continuous dock doors on BOTH long faces; estimated ~90 total - count approximate, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers parked in rows along the W dock apron / drop yard; ~25-50 stalls, hard to separate active staging from storage.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Curved internal driveway from Lewis Centre Way into the yard has room to stack 3+ trucks before the dock apron.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Grove City is part of the Columbus OH metro; site sits in a built-up multi-tenant industrial park flanked by other big-box warehouses and suburban residential - Urban.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: FedEx occupies one long building; adjacent big-box warehouses are separate tenants, not part of the FedEx campus.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single FedEx cross-dock building; FedEx branding confirmed on the building face in 2025 Street View.
